scope: Native pthread cleanup callees retire wrapped-worker startup on actual exec, adopt replacement task ownership and permit explicit resume of retained abandoned-handle leases. Bounded automatic signal forwarding applies to all call stages. Leader/nonleader exec, detach/event-inspection retry and returning signal-interrupted pthread detachers with application liveness. Original CLONE_VM peers remain readable and wrapped-worker replacements copy their old private frame. No universal compatibility claim. x86-64, native i386, ARM64 4/64 KiB profiles. No universal compatibility claim.

reproduction.interpretation: The original wrapped-worker startup retains its resource owner and replacement EXEC stop; plain abandoned leases reject explicit resume of an actual SIGUSR1 stop. Initial failure run reached those assertions but its destructor then waited for a killed leader whose traced sibling exit had not been reaped; terminated by its alarm. Corrected fixture drains only the known selected sibling and leader with bounded waits. Recompiled original call_service.cpp using the current driver and unchanged target_syscall object with original shared core, matching the previous snapshot. Four-case baseline completes and fails 12 of 37 reached checks; the same four cases pass all 49 checks after the fix, with replacement readiness enabling twelve liveness assertions. Final expanded full driver requires all 395 checks.

previousSnapshots.note: Previous snapshots are historical evidence. No new single-CPU full concurrency claim.

resourceUse.nativeI386: Actual ELF32 target on the host kernel with copied i386 glibc/loader. Fixture linked to glibc CRT directly because host multilib libgcc is unavailable; no CPU emulation.

limitations: Required remote CI and release execution pending.

An already-exited leader, unrelated sibling exec and multiple borrowed contexts per group require additional live coverage. Calls without TRACEEXEC and cleanup transfer to another old-mm process remain pending.
GP write rejection uses real EXEC wait status; does not prove every register bank was unchanged.
Private-page affinity proof requires stated proc-mem/mapping permissions.
Other architectures, managed runtimes, Wine/Proton/container variants and remote ownership/disconnect cases remain incomplete.
